title: Argentine deputy Marcela Pagano claims in a criminal complaint that the Chamber of Deputies' systems were hacked and the attack concealed
date_note: Perfil's article of 25 Nov reports the complaint; the page gives no earlier day for the filing, so the publication day is used.
org: Cámara de Diputados de la Nación (Argentina)
geo_basis: Argentine Chamber of Deputies, seat in Buenos Aires; the source does not state a city for the systems
summary: According to Perfil, deputy Marcela Pagano filed a criminal complaint alleging Chamber president Martín Menem concealed a cyberattack on Congress's systems. On 26 November Perfil reported that Menem announced a preventive closure of access to part of the Chamber's systems, citing a global escalation of AI-supported cyberattacks. His statement named no specific successful attack, Perfil says.
plain: A deputy alleges the Chamber of Deputies was hacked and the matter hidden. The Chamber's president announced a preventive closure of some systems, citing AI-supported attacks, without naming a successful attack, Perfil reports.
exec: An allegation, not an established breach: the Chamber's president cited AI-supported attacks for restricting system access, per Perfil.

sources.name: Perfil: Marcela Pagano denuncia que hackearon el sitio de Diputados y el Gobierno lo oculta
Perfil: Menem anunció el cierre preventivo de sistemas de Diputados ante el riesgo de ciberataques con inteligencia artificial

validation.note: Only Perfil (noticias.perfil.com and perfil.com are one publisher) was read; it relays the deputy's complaint and, on 26 Nov, the Chamber president's announcement of preventive closure, which names no specific successful attack.

review.note: stronger than the source: no explanation changed to no complete technical explanation per Perfil; plain and exec aligned
